question: is the Korean source ready to become the submission source

blocking_gap.why_it_blocks: the reference list printed by a citation-order style contains only cited works, so a body citing six sources ships a bibliography of six. That is not a formatting difference; it means the Korean text does not yet carry the evidence the draft rests on.

defects_found_and_fixed_during_the_attem.cause: the formatter numbered headings that already carried their own numeral
defects_found_and_fixed_during_the_attem.fix: a heading that already begins with a numeral is counted and left alone

defects_found_and_fixed_during_the_attem.defect: the reference list was numbered as a sixth chapter
defects_found_and_fixed_during_the_attem.cause: the same numbering pass treated it as a chapter
defects_found_and_fixed_during_the_attem.fix: the reference heading is excluded from chapter numbering

decision: hold the switch behind a flag in the protocol, keep building the submission from the draft, and flip the flag only when the Korean body cites what the work rests on
why_not_lower_the_gate: the reference-count check is what detected the gap. Lowering it would have shipped a thesis whose bibliography silently shrank from ninety-three works to six.
